from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """Extracted classification for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title or heading of the judgment document")
    case_type: Literal['行政案件', '执行案件', '刑事案件'] = Field(description="The legal case type of this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentClassification]
